description: Defines classes and functions for Huffman decoding in HPACK, including HuffmanBitBuffer and HpackHuffmanDecoder, used for incremental Huffman decoding in HTTP/2 HPACK compression.

classes.name: HuffmanBitBuffer
classes.description: Manages bit buffer for Huffman decoding, allowing appending bytes, consuming bits, and checking termination.

classes.name: HpackHuffmanDecoder
classes.description: Performs incremental Huffman decoding of HPACK-encoded strings, maintaining internal bit buffer state.

methods.name: HuffmanBitBuffer::Reset
methods.description: Prepares the buffer for decoding a new Huffman string.

methods.name: HuffmanBitBuffer::AppendBytes
methods.description: Adds bytes to the bit buffer for decoding.

methods.name: HuffmanBitBuffer::ConsumeBits
methods.description: Consumes specified number of bits from the buffer.

methods.name: HuffmanBitBuffer::InputProperlyTerminated
methods.description: Checks if the bit buffer is properly terminated according to RFC.

methods.name: HpackHuffmanDecoder::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a Huffman-encoded string fragment into output, handling partial input.

methods.name: HpackHuffmanDecoder::Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state for a new decoding operation.
